title: Najran Cement reports profit fall in third quarter of 2026
summary: Najran Cement reports profit fall in third quarter of 2026
body_markdown:
**Saudi Arabia:** On 11 November 2026 Najran Cement Company announced that its net loss attributable to shareholders reached US$3.7m in the third quarter of 2026, ending 30 September 2026, compared with a net profit of US$799,000 in the corresponding period of 2025.


The company recorded an operating loss of US$2.2m in the third quarter of 2026, compared with an operating profit of US$2.5m in the corresponding quarter of 2025. Net loss for the nine-month period was US$639,000, compared with a net profit of US$6.7m in the same period of 2025.
